segments.an4.59:1.1: “Bhojanaṃ, bhikkhave, dadamāno dāyako paṭiggāhakānaṃ cattāri ṭhānāni deti.
segments.an4.59:1.3: Āyuṃ deti, vaṇṇaṃ deti, sukhaṃ deti, balaṃ deti.
segments.an4.59:1.4: Āyuṃ kho pana datvā āyussa bhāgī hoti dibbassa vā mānusassa vā.
segments.an4.59:1.5: Vaṇṇaṃ datvā … sukhaṃ datvā … balaṃ datvā balassa bhāgī hoti dibbassa vā mānusassa vā.
segments.an4.59:1.6: Bhojanaṃ, bhikkhave, dadamāno dāyako paṭiggāhakānaṃ imāni cattāri ṭhānāni detī”ti.
segments.an4.59:3.1: “So āyudāyī vaṇṇadāyī, sukhaṃ balaṃ dado naro;
